description: The International Relations Seminar this spring explores order and empire in international relations. Set against the backdrop of a rapidly changing world, each book explores a distinct vision of change and stability at key moments in global history. The course emphasizes the theoretical approaches scholars use to examine past, present, and future interactions between and among political entities. Students will submit a substantial research paper applying theoretical perspectives and historical insight on a topic agreed to with their instructor. Prerequisites: PSCI 220 and one course in the subfield, or permission of instructor.
name: Sem: International Relations
notes: This course is open only to rising seniors and juniors.
